parole.significato: to skid, to spin around without traction (of a car or its wheels)
parole.testo: Uncertain: * бу́кса (búksa, “metal box in which a train axle rotates and into which oil is poured”) + -ова́ть (-ovátʹ). * From Polish buksować, further from Dutch boegseren, whence also букси́ровать (buksírovatʹ), букси́р (buksír).
From Polish reja + -ка (-ka), from Dutch ra.
